headline: I post on X about 3 times a day on average. Posting takes me maybe 15 to 20 minutes a day at most I don't overthink it, I post the moment I think of something, and most of the material is stuff I've already said out loud to someone in person
My bet on how we'll work: you don't type, you don't write documents, you talk and the work gets done in real time, from a beach if you want. The latency between talking and doing should be zero.

headline: 9500亿是纸面繁荣：SK海力士签的不是大单，是卖身契

headline: 黄仁勋、马斯克，最新涉华表态！
abstract: 马斯克表示，中国极有可能成为AI领导者，美国禁用中国模型也无法阻挡。黄仁勋盛赞中国开源AI大模型非常优秀，呼吁向中国学习与合作；他明确反对美国限制或禁用中国开源模型，认为应允许美国公司使用，并联合多家科技巨头发布公开信，为开源AI全面辩护。
